last_summary: The strongest supported causal chain is in v1: the cabin is attached before the dump bed, and the later dump-bed-to-chassis positioning is obstructed by the already-mounted cabin. This best matches option B, Video 1: Attach dump bed and chassis. v2/v3 lack direct wrong-order error evidence, and the cabin-to-chassis step itself does not show the observed fit failure. Some uncertainty remains because the dump-bed seating error is partly occluded, but the required focus stages are complete and B is the best-supported choice.
